versions.subject: Merge PR #4969 from @Mahir-Ali-khan - Add `Potential File Override/Append Via SET Command`
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'Cmd.Exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/c set /p='
        - '"set /p='
        - '>>*set /p=' # To catch edge cases where the attacker passes it via a "cmd /c"
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\cmd.exe" OR OriginalFileName="Cmd.Exe" CommandLine IN ("*/c set /p=*", "*\"set /p=*", "*>>*set /p=*")
